scope: Private independent artifact integrity check only. No second origin, semantic assessment, behavior experiment, model-quality experiment or candidate approval.

attempts.cause: Checker incorrectly treated protocol.axes object entries as strings, causing 195 vocabulary and 144 coverage-key false positives. Its forbidden-field scan also incorrectly treated the execution-ledger new_labels=0 counter as a label feature. The 340 failures were checker errors, not artifact defects.

attempts.checker_changes: Read each protocol axis object's id. Accept only the exact zero-valued review/execution_ledger/new_labels counter while continuing to reject label features and nonzero new-label counters.

remaining_limit: This checker verifies exact bytes, recorded ranges, pointer joins, cardinality, protocol states and record references. It does not prove the natural-language judgments, general whole-program closure, independent data origin, runtime performance or training readiness. The producer's separate byte-check failure/retry counters were read as declared provenance, not executed or counted as this checker's invocations.
